messages:
emily: Quick sync notes from Ampere call — they want to run a small hardware preview but need NDA + bench spec by EOW.
rafael: Do we have a minimal allowed workload list? we should forbid any customer PII or customers' models.
tasha: We'll run only synthetic prompts + our evaluation set. I'll attach the prompt list to the doc.
jordan_ampere: Ampere can start infra prep once NDA is signed. They prefer a short MOU + telemetry clause.
emily: Proposed bench set: rwd-6b, rwd-13b; seq=512/1024; batch sizes 1,2,4; 3 warmup runs, 50 measured iterations. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU mem peak, power_avg.
rafael: Also capture cold-start latency and OOM/failure counts. Add tokenizer hash and model checksum.
legal: We can use the partner NDA template but need to add a one-way telemetry use clause. timeline: ~5-7 biz days for review.
jordan_ampere: That's fine. Ampere legal will prioritize if we keep redlines minimal.
devops-bot: note: Please provide SSH key or IAM role for s3 access. recommend ephemeral creds.
emily: Delivery plan: (1) Legal -> NDA draft today, (2) Rafael -> bench harness + docker image by Thu, (3) Tasha -> prompt set + allowed inputs, (4) Jordan -> infra contact and expected power telemetry fields.
rafael: I'll publish image: `registry.redwood/infer-eap:ampere-preview-1` and a `run_preview.sh` wrapper. Example: `./run_preview.sh --model rwd-13b --seq 1024 --batch 2 --iters 50 --out s3://rwd-ampere-preview/results/`.
tasha: Will add strict runbook: no real customer data, only curated evals; we will verify tokenized inputs before accepting results.
jordan_ampere: Ampere will provide a contact for logs and add power draw metrics (per-GPU avg).
emily: Communication: this is a private preview. PM/comms ok with a partner blog co-authored after mutual approval. No public numbers until both sides sign off.
legal: once NDA is signed we can circulate a short data handling addendum.
devops-bot: calendar: Ampere preview kickoff tentatively 2026-04-07 09:00 PT (invite pending).
emily: Thanks — keeping this thread as the source-of-truth. If anyone hits blockers ping here or DM. :thumbsup:
